name: roster-manager-template
description: A minimal EXTERNAL Roster manager for Pantessa — own key, public API only (GET /api/roster/feed + POST /api/broker/mcp), no Pantessa internals. Discovers a listed slot, courts it, proposes ONE $-priced in-mandate under-cap open, polls status, handles declined/benched/fired honestly. Dry-run by default. Built to SECOND-MANAGER-CONTRACT.md.
